avis.titre: Gentle exfoliator that doesn’t irritate my skin.Gentle exfoliator that doesn’t irritate my skin.
avis.texte: I have dry, sensitive skin, so I’m always careful about the products I use on my face. Before this, I had only tried one exfoliator and it left my skin feeling very dry, so I was hesitant to try another one. I decided to give this one a chance because rice-based products have worked well for me, and it feels very gentle on my skin. It doesn’t irritate or leave my face red. As I massage it in, it forms small, soft flakes, and after rinsing my skin feels smoother and looks more even. I haven’t been using it for very long, but so far I really like how it leaves my skin. It doesn’t leave that tight or dry feeling, which is very important to me.

Gentle Korean exfoliant from a company that I trust. I didn't notice any unpleasant odor as other have commented on. Applied with a dropper and provides good value for the price. I'd definitely purchase again. Compared to some other exfoliants on the market, this one is definitely gentler.

I am a daily Mixsoon user. I praise all of their proucts which are the best for ultra-senitive skin. All of their products are gentle on skin, but in this case, the Ampoule may be too gentle which does not make it as effective in peeling dead skin layers compared to other ampoules I have used. Mixed feelings on this one, it works, but others are better at exfoliating. Upside is that it will not irritate where others have. I am using it up, but probably will not reorder which makes me sad because I have been extremely satisfied with this skincare line.
I haven't been using it for that long bit it has helped with hyperpigmentation already! Also, I have not had any irritation so far.

avis.titre: My Skin Looks So Much Better!My Skin Looks So Much Better!
avis.texte: really love this product! It leaves my skin feeling soft, smooth, and hydrated. After using it consistently, my skin looks brighter and healthier. It has a lightweight texture, absorbs quickly, and doesn’t feel sticky. I will definitely keep using it and highly recommend it!
So far so good I use 2 x a week in am doesn’t irritate my skin leaves is very smooth and prepped for serum

avis.auteur: Me gusta la serie de colores para cada d
avis.texte: Love the way my skin feels when I’m finished. Is very gentle in my skin.

Let’s just cut straight to what everyone wants to know — how does it stack up to the Dr. Melaxin one? I’d say they’re comparable and this is a better value (you get more product for less money). The formula of this one is thinner but it seems to take off the same amount of dead skin in the comparison tests I’ve done on myself. Neither of these products are going to actually remove your blackheads like influencers keep saying (the only product I’ve found that REMOVES blackheads is the Ilso sebum softener & then you use a scraper tool to actually remove the blackheads — but I don’t recommend that to people, esp younger people, because it’s EASY to overdo it with that and seriously damage your skin if you don’t know what you’re doing) but properly exfoliating is the best thing you can do towards getting rid of them and keep them from reforming. Not that anyone asked, but in my opinion the biggest problem I see with most of my fellow American’s skin is not regularly GENTLY exfoliating… most people want to do a really harsh exfoliant that scrapes up their skin like once a month, which causes damage and puts them in a bad cycle with their skin. Regular gentle exfoliation with a product like this (2-3x a week) is going to help your skin recover and heal while getting rid of the things that clog it up (dead skin, sebum, dirt, waste products) and cause skin ailments. This ampoule does a good job of fully getting rid of everything that needs to come off without stripping my skin or dam

avis.titre: Feels like I have tiny fuzzies all over my face
avis.texte: If you've experienced wiping your hands on a towel that lets out its towel fuzzies/fibers onto your hand and then you apply topicals to your skin and feel the fuzzies against your face, this is the same feeling. I personally didn't like it as it felt like my face was full of the fibers. Therefore, I do recommend this as an exfoliant, but to rinse off after use, so more so as a cleanser. It is scentless and a milky white coloring. Made in Korea and box was sealed prior to use.

This ampoule turned out to be a wonderful surprise -- much more like a lightweight hydrating serum than a typical exfoliant. The texture is thin and silky, gliding over the skin effortlessly without leaving any residue or tackiness. I really appreciate that it relies on rice-based ingredients instead of strong acids. It reminds me of a J-beauty exfoliant I used to use which was similar -- you massage, then dead skin rolls off. Anyway, each time I massage it in, it feels soothing and never triggers irritation, tightness, or redness. After rinsing, my skin feels clean, soft, and refreshed, with a smoother surface that looks refined rather than overly polished. I also notice that my skin stays moisturized longer on days I use it. The combination of Mixsoon peeling ampoule softens dry areas while gently lifting buildup, and the soy proteins seem to gradually improve my skin’s texture. Even when my skin is a little on the sensitive side, it never stings or causes discomfort. With steady use, my complexion looks brighter and more even. This has quickly become the exfoliating step I use when I want something reliable yet gentle enough for frequent use. It layers easily into my routine and keeps my skin looking calm, hydrated, and clear. Overall I’m impressed. It performs beautifully, has no fragrance (a huge plus for sensitive skin), and leaves the skin soft and nourished. For the quality, the price feels completely reasonable. Mixsoon continues to be one of my go-to K-beauty brands

I think by now everyone knows about the brightening and refreshing effects of rice on the skin. I got the Mixsoon White Rice Peeling Ampoule at the right season and started using it regularly to prepare my skin for summer. The product gently exfoliates, removes dead skin cells, and leaves my skin looking brighter, fresher, and smoother. Its texture is very light, it has no overpowering scent, and it didn’t cause any irritation on my sensitive skin. I’ve always been a bit cautious about using peeling products in the summer because of the higher risk of sun-induced spots, so I waited for the right time. With regular use, I really noticed visible brightness and a whitening effect. Even though it’s now winter, I didn’t skip my sunscreen afterward. Despite my sensitive skin, I experienced no discomfort at all. I’m definitely satisfied and will continue using it. It works especially well in winter alongside my moisturizer.

This one was a bit meh for me personally, though I can absolutely see how it could be helpful for the right person. I use a non-rinse exfoliating acid treatment a few times a week that keeps my skin smooth and clear of buildup, and my skin is fairly resilient. Because of that, this didn’t add much to my routine. Even so, I did give it a fair try and tested it on four different occasions. The texture is lightweight and creamy with a bit of slip. It doesn’t have much body, so it’s on the runnier side, but it’s not sticky at all and is completely fragrance free. It comes in a nice glass bottle with a very long dropper, although no matter how much I squeezed, I could only ever get the dropper about half full. However, since I only needed a half dozen drops for my whole face, that didn’t really matter in the long run - in light of that though, the super long dropper seems oddly out of place here. This serum is designed to be massaged into the skin and then rinsed off with water. As you massage it in, the cellulose in the formula balls up and provides a very gentle physical exfoliation. It’s important to note that what you’re seeing roll up is the cellulose itself, not bits of dry skin being exfoliated away. Despite the name, you’re not going to see a dramatic peeling effect with this, even though it’s called a peeling ampoule. Please don’t be put off by the fact that this is a physical exfoliation. This is nothing like harsh apricot or walnut shell scrubs. There’s no gritty or scr

For reference, I have sensitive skin that tends to be a little more on the dry side. I love that the serum doesn’t have any fragrance to it. It blends well with your other facial products without the extra scent. The exfoliant feels very gentle on your skin and isn’t uncomfortable when rubbing it in. It is a very gentle exfoliant, so if you’re looking for something a little more intense, this isn’t it. It easily washes off of your skin. My skin wasn’t red or irritated after use. Nor did it feel overly dry. This is great for those with very sensitive skin. I personally do not love the way the serum looks, if you know what I mean, but that’s not affecting the overall quality.

avis.titre: Unscented but leaves residue, messy to use
avis.texte: This review is for mixsoon White Rice Peeling Ampoule - White rice exfoliant, Gentle Exfoliating Serum for Smooth, Radiant Skin, Dead Skin Cells Remover 100ml / 3.38 fl.oz. Korean Glass Skin Care, which is made in Korea. I used the black version of this before so I had some idea of how it would perform. The liquid here is thick and has a fine grit in it that you massage in to exfoliate the skin. The liquid thickens slightly and forms little globs, but not as much as the black version does. The globs do make a little bit of a mess so be careful when washing off. I prefer to wipe them off with a wet wipe first as I’m concerned about the buildup in the sink drain with repeated use. The product left a little residue on the skin so I had to use a cleanser afterwards. It also does not tell you WHEN to use this product? Are you supposed to use it before a cleanser or after? I cleansed my face first and then used this but when I washed off the globs of product it left a residue on my face so I had to cleanse again. At a price of $40.00 for 3.38 oz, I think this is pretty expensive and it was not a good value for the money for me personally, although I love Mixsoon products. The mess and extra steps made it lose a star for me. I did not experience any irritation when using the product and you can see the ingredient list in the final image.

avis.titre: Four-and-a-half stars; Excellent, but dropper doesn't work well
avis.texte: mixsoon White Rice Peeling Ampoule - White rice exfoliant is a fairly viscous white liquid that is delivered by a very long dropper. I seem to be having problems with droppers lately--this one as well. This dropper refuses to pick up very much liquid, so I have to dunk it in the bottle about three or four times to get enough liquid to cover my face. When I do get enough liquid, however, it works. This peeling ampoule, as it is referred to here, is highly effective. It is one of the products that, when rubbed on skin, begins to pill up. This serves as a facial exfoliator. The mixsoon ampoule takes a few seconds of gentle massage to get it started, but eventually the liquid starts turning into tiny balls of semi-solidified product and the true exfoliation begins! I continue massaging the remaining liquid and the soft rolls against my complexion, until I am pretty sure I have massaged my entire face. This only needs to be rinsed off with water. My skin loves this particular ampoule. My face feels so soft after I use it, and more importantly, NOT dry. This peeling ampoule also takes care of some dry patches of skin, and assists in exfoliation. Is this worth the price point? I am not sure. This is a very good product, but I believe it is slightly overpriced, given the difficulty with the dropper. I think that the dropper should work smoothly and efficiently when charging higher prices. The packaging is muted, and the bottle itself is discreet. But certainly I think that I should b

This is a great skin cleanser, you put it on in circular motion and clean it off. You can feel the little exfoliating things in the mix. My skin feels smooth after use. I do wish it was more of a peel mask, as that’s how I assumed it would be with peeling in the name. Overall it’s a great product.

avis.titre: Gentle exfoliant with great natural ingredients. Skin after use was noticeably brighter/very soft.
avis.texte: I am a big fan of this Korean exfoliating ampoule. The first listed ingredient is rice seed water, which is known for its hydrating, brightening, and soothing properties. My skin is sensitive and prone to redness. Using this provided a very gentle and soothing exfoliation. After use the redness in my skin was less pronounced and my skin was very soft and hydrated. I like to incorporate an exfoliant into my skin care routine, but, because my skin is so sensitive, I stay away from anything abrasive so this product was a perfect fit for me. The bottle is 3.38 ounces, and will last me a while using this daily. Considering the ingredients and the noticeable effects from this product, I consider it a good value at $40, which was the cost at the time I selected it. However, checking the price today, I saw that this is on sale for $24, which is such a great deal that I bought a second one!

This is a really interesting exfoliating ampoule. I got both the White Rice and Black Rice versions. The white rice one seems to have slightly harder physical exfoliant particles. I used them immediately after cleansing because I wasn't sure which step I was supposed to use them at but the instructions indicate they need to be rinsed off after use so I wanted to do it before toner or anything else I wanted to fully absorb into my skin. I don't know if you're really supposed to use both the White and Black versions in the same skincare routine, either, but my skin was extremely smooth and soft afterwards so I'm not bad about it even though I don't typically use physical exfoliants on my face. These are made in Korea, where they have very high standards for manufacturing and ingredients in cosmetics.

avis.titre: Gentle for my dry skin, no fragrance
avis.texte: My skin has been really dry lately from the change in season to the colder weather and I’ve been really struggling with my regular exfoliator (actually I use the Mixsoon bean oil to exfoliate but it’s too drastic to my skin barrier right now to be removing filaments.) This gentle exfoliator somehow manages to make my skin feel very soft and smooth yet not totally irritated and stripped. I don’t know if it’s the product bunching on contact with skin oils or dead skin or both but it quickly creates a gentle exfoliation and when you rinse it off it feels really soothed. I love that this doesn’t have an added fragrance so it’s perfect for sensitive skin. I would definitely buy this again.

I use the dropper to put about a quarter size amount in my hand. Then I massage it into y face gentle for about 5 minutes. Then, I rinse with slightly warm water and pat dry. It’s a gentle exfoliation and great for even sensitive skin like mine. I really love the quality of the mission products, one of my favorite k-beauty brands. Manufactured Sept 29, 2025 and expires Sept 28, 2028.
